title: Thermodynamics
coreMove: Price the maintenance energy a system needs before treating visible order as stable.
sourcePressure: Thermodynamics is about order, energy, entropy, drift, maintenance, and displaced disorder, kept practical rather than scientific.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: using entropy as a loose metaphor for messiness or complaining about decline
